app.title: Guardian for a Day
app.tagline: Design the sensor network of a real monument, then see what the ARGUS experts did.
app.loadError: Sorry, the game data could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
app.crash: Sorry, something went wrong in the game. Reload the page to start again.
app.footer: Real data from the ARGUS project (snapshot of {date}). Story texts, sensor costs and scores were written by the game team.
steps.label: Progress
home.intro: Old buildings are in danger from water, weather, insects and people. Today you choose the sensors that watch over one of them. Then you find out what the ARGUS experts really installed.
home.how1: Read the story of the monument.
home.how2: Spend your coins on sensors that can warn us about three dangers.
home.how3: Compare your choices with the real ARGUS sensors.
home.how4: Replay a real alarm from 2026: would your sensors have noticed?
home.levelHelp: Experts rated every danger at this monument, from Low to Catastrophic. More serious dangers come with more coins, as real monitoring budgets grow with the risk.
story.mission: Protect the monument from three dangers. You have {coins} to spend on sensors.
mission.heading: Build your sensor network
mission.done: Done! Show me what ARGUS did
mission.needOne: Add at least one sensor first.
reveal.heading: What ARGUS really installed
reveal.intro: ARGUS has {n} instruments at this monument. Some sit together on one device and measure several things at once.
reveal.satelliteNote: One of them is not on the building: it is a layer of satellite images.
reveal.tableCaption: Your sensors next to the ARGUS sensors
reveal.noWrong: There is no single right answer. The real experts had to choose too. Every difference is a good question to talk about.
reveal.promptMany: ARGUS installed {n} × {name}. Why might one not be enough?
reveal.promptOnlyYou: You chose: {name}. ARGUS did not install one here. What would it add?
reveal.promptOnlyArgus: ARGUS installed: {name}, and you did not. Which danger could it be watching?
event.heading: A real alarm
event.timesBelow: That is only {pct}% of the limit.
event.question: Would your network have noticed?
event.yes: Yes! It would have been caught by: {names}.
event.no: No. To catch it you needed: {names}.
event.source: Source: ARGUS alarm, rule {rule}, event record {ids}.
event.dataNote: Real data from {from} to {to}. Some sensors showed impossible values, so we left those alarms out.
event.flatNote: This sensor showed almost the same value for many days. Experts would also check that the sensor itself works: sensors can break too.
event.none: There is no usable real alarm for this monument yet.
score.heading: Your score
score.threats: Dangers watched: {full} fully and {partial} partly, of {total}
score.efficiency: Coins spent on helpful sensors: {useful} of {spent}
score.noSensor: No sensor can warn us about this, and neither can one observer. It needs the whole community: people who learn, remember and take care.
score.communityLocal: Saved anonymously, only on this device. No names are stored.
score.communityCount: Games at this level on this device: {n}
score.communityTop: Most chosen sensor: {name} (in {pct}% of games). ARGUS installed {argus} of them here.
score.communityFirst: Nobody has played this level here before you. Your choices are saved for the next players.
home.mapHint: Tap a monument on the map, or choose it here.
mission.placeHint: Move the map so the cross is where you want a sensor, then press +. Tap the map to move the cross. You can drag sensors on the map.
mission.placed: Placed at the cross on the map.
reveal.promptDistance: {name}: yours is {n} m from the nearest one ARGUS installed. Why do you think they put it there?
reveal.mapNote: On the map, circles are your sensors and squares are the ARGUS sensors. A number means several sensors in one spot. Where you put them does not change your score.
event.mapNote: On the map, a ring marks the ARGUS sensor that raised the alarm.
map.label: Map of {name}
map.overviewLabel: Map of the five ARGUS monuments
map.instructions: Arrow keys move the map. Plus and minus zoom in and out. Sensors on the map are buttons.
map.tempPosition: Position not yet confirmed by ARGUS
map.tilesFailed: The map pictures could not load. Your sensors are still shown.
map.planFallback: Satellite pictures cannot load here, so you see a simple plan instead.
score.alarmYes: Real alarm: your network would have caught it
score.alarmNo: Real alarm: your network would have missed it
score.scaled: There is no real alarm to replay at this level, so your score is out of the other parts.
score.partialBy: Your sensors help a little: {names}. But they do not watch this danger directly.
event.counts: Catching the real alarm counts in your score.
event.human: People notice things no instrument measures, but they do not measure day and night. Alarms like this one are caught by instruments.
reveal.human: You also chose: {name}. The ARGUS list shows instruments only, so people are not in the table. Yet guards, staff and visitors notice things no instrument measures. What could they see here?
event.whatAi: On {date}, the ARGUS artificial-intelligence system noticed something unusual {measures}.
event.aiHow: This system has no fixed limit. It learns how the sensors usually behave and raises an alarm when something departs from the usual.
event.aiShare: This sensor explains {pct}% of the alarm, more than any other.
event.episode: It was not a one-off: ARGUS raised this alarm {n} times, from {start} to {end}.
event.sourceAi: Source: ARGUS artificial-intelligence alarm, event record {ids}.
event.noneScore: So this step does not count in your score.
quiz.preIntro: This is not a test. Answer as you think best: at the end you will get the same questions and see what you learned.
quiz.postIntro: Let's see what you learned while playing.
quiz.needAll: Please answer every question first. Question {n} has no answer yet.
quiz.compare: Before the game: {pre} of {total} right. Now: {post} of {total}.
quiz.device: On this device, over {n} games: on average {pre} of {total} right before the game and {post} after.
quiz.saved: Answers are saved anonymously, only on this device. No names are stored.
quiz.inviteText: Answer the 5 questions again and compare with before.
class.title: Playing with your class?
class.help: If your teacher gave you a class code, enter it here. Your choices will count together with your class. No names are stored.
class.label: Class code (6 letters and numbers)
class.invalid: That is not a class code. Check the 6 letters and numbers and try again.
class.in: You are in class {code}. Your choices count together with your class.
teacher.title: For teachers
teacher.intro: Create a class code and share it with your students. Then see what your class chose, next to what ARGUS really installed, and what they learned in the quiz.
teacher.share: Students can type this code on the first screen, or open this link:
teacher.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the link and copy it by hand.
teacher.localNote: This game has no shared server set up, so you see only the games played on this device. Students can take turns on one tablet or computer.
teacher.sharedNote: You see every game played with this code, on any device.
teacher.error: The results could not be loaded. Try again.
teacher.empty: No games with this code yet.
teacher.quiz: Quiz, over {n} games: on average {pre} of {total} right before playing and {post} after.
teacher.tableCaption: {name}: what the class chose (% of {n} games) and what ARGUS installed (number)
score.communityShared: Saved anonymously, together with every other player. No names are stored.
quiz.class: Your class, over {n} games: on average {pre} of {total} right before the game and {post} after.
quiz.everyone: All players, over {n} games: on average {pre} of {total} right before the game and {post} after.
quiz.savedShared: Answers are saved anonymously, together with every other player. No names are stored.
citizen.title: Be an observer too
citizen.intro: Sensors do not see everything. When you visit a monument, look out for:
share.text: I was a guardian for a day at {name} and scored {score} out of 100. Want to try?
share.copied: The text and the link were copied.
share.failed: Could not share. Copy the address from the address bar instead.
mission.guideHelp: The numbers on the map show the main parts of the site. Choose one to move the map there, then add sensors with +.
map.movedTo: Map moved to {name}. New sensors go there.
mission.trayHint: Tap a sensor to put it at the cross, or drag it onto the map.
mission.dropMissed: Drop the sensor on the map to place it.
reveal.argusCost: At game prices, the ARGUS sensors here would cost about {argus} coins. You had {budget}: real monitoring also has to choose.
event.riskTitle: What ARGUS's risk model did next
event.riskIntro: Every day ARGUS works out again how likely each danger is. Above {watch}%, a danger goes on watch.
event.justAbove: That is just above the limit.
